Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
Hello,

I've been part of this community for more than 20 years. I've travelled a lot, I've played games with many people. And one thing that has always amazed me is what players come up with for the Edge.

I've seen many, many Edges - some are amazing of creativity, some are absolutely terrible (don't use a lighter when more than one person at the table smokes).

edgesoftheworld.com is a place to share and celebrate our Edges.

Check what other people around the world are using to mess with the political decks.
Take pictures of Edges during a tournament.
Vote for your favourite picture.
Best picture gets promoted (and maybe I'll make a slide show).

I've set the upload window to under a week, and the voting window to two weeks. Earlier events are still available for browsing.

If anything goes wrong, there is a contact form that will send me an email.
If you've got GRPD concerns, deleting your account will remove every picture you've taken and will un-cast all the votes you cast.
This is my first website, so I expect a lot of things to go wrong. I've already fixed so many bits, added so many CSS and javascript lines that, really, what other grid layout could be broken now?

Check it out, and feel free to upload pictures

edgesoftheworld.com

Pascal

[PS: Lots of thanks to Sérgio for nudging me enough to finish this]
